newsitem.title: USA: Telident sets up cost control program.
newsitem.headline: Telident sets up cost control program.

text.p: Telident Inc said on Tuesday it will launch personnel and other cost reductions in response to lower-than-expected sales.
Further details were not immediately available.

Meanwhile, Telident said it was pleased by the Federal Communications Commission approving the use of 3-1-1 for non-emergency direct calls to authorities. However, the company said 3-1-1 does not address previous problems that businesses, schools and government offices have had with the 9-1-1 network, which is Telident's primary market.
Telident designs and sells systems that provide the exact location source of a 9-1-1 emergency call.
